gRPC client logic for bundle auth, subscriptions, keepalive, and transaction forwarding.

# Purpose
`fd_bundle_client.c` implements the client side of the bundle gRPC connection used by the bundle tile. It manages TCP connection setup, optional TLS setup, HTTP/2 and gRPC I/O, keepalive PING traffic, reconnect backoff, and connection state reporting. The file also drives the authentication flow through `fd_bundle_auther`, requests block builder fee information, and starts the two long-lived subscriptions for packets and bundles.

The file also handles incoming gRPC responses and converts them into internal transaction messages for the tango message bus. It decodes Protobuf messages for `SubscribePacketsResponse`, `SubscribeBundlesResponse`, and `BlockBuilderFeeInfoResponse`, validates packet size and builder data, and publishes regular transactions and bundle transactions with `fd_stem_publish`. It updates metrics, tracks bundle sequence and transaction counts, and exposes the callback table `fd_bundle_client_grpc_callbacks` that connects the gRPC client layer to this bundle client logic.
